channel.title: Evangelical Times Limited - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Evangelical Times Limited (evangelical-times.org)

item.title: The Americans are right: national renewal is impossible without rebuilding marriage
item.description: For more than a decade, the official story has been simple: the redefinition of marriage was ‘settled’, and anyone still defending the mother and father bond was clinging to the past.

item.title: Iran: Prayers needed for peace, justice, and freedom
item.description: Christian religious freedom agencies are calling for prayers for Iran, that the attacks by American and Israeli forces will lead to more liberty in the Islamic nation.

item.title: A victory for life in Scotland
item.description: Christians across the United Kingdom have good reason to give thanks to God following the Scottish Parliament’s rejection of a bill to legalise assisted suicide by 69 votes to 57.

item.title: The prayer meeting and food waste
item.description: Here’s a helpful way to understand the role of the mid-week prayer meeting in the life of the church: it’s there to stop food waste. In the UK, 9.5 million tonnes of good food are thrown away every year – even though 8.4 million people are classified as in ‘food poverty’. What a waste!

item.title: Salisbury Reformed Seminary students graduate
item.description: A special meeting was held at Emmanuel Church, Salisbury, on 5 January when students at Salisbury Reformed Seminary graduated, having completed their three-year course.

item.title: Video: what’s missing in evangelical preaching today?
item.description: What’s missing from Reformed Evangelical preaching today? Watch this video, and see if you agree.

item.title: Obituary: Andrew Anderson
item.description: Andrew Anderson, former president of the FIEC, was called home on 1 November 2025. Born in 1935 in Mill Hill, London, Andrew was converted at an early age. He trained at London Bible College before pastoring a church in Kent for eight years.

item.title: A Heart for Soldiers: Louisa and Georgiana Daniell and The Miss Daniell’s Homes
item.description: This biography introduces Louisa Daniell, who, in her own day, was classed alongside Florence Nightingale as an inspirational, philanthropic lady.

item.title: A Heart Aflame for God: A Reformed Approach to Spiritual Formation
item.description: The author is writing principally to bring Reformed and biblical thinking to what is called spiritual formation. Some evangelicals have been drawn into modern spiritual formation techniques borrowed from other religious traditions.

item.title: Irenaeus of Lyons
item.description: We don’t know much about Ireneaus. Born in second-century Smyrna, he eventually became bishop of Lyons in France. So the author calls this an ‘intellectual biography’. Though we know little of Irenaeus, we have his great work ‘Against All Heresies’.
